description: Create a new smart link in a Ulinkly project. Supports unified links (single URL that routes by platform) and dynamic links (parameterised deep links). You must specify the project, domain, and link type. Optionally set platform-specific URLs, fallback URLs, custom slug, metadata, and parameters. Pass externalId (any stable string from your system) to make creation idempotent on (project, externalId).

allowQueryPassthrough.description: When true, query params appended to this link URL at click time (e.g. ?orderId=123) are merged into the resolved link's parameters and OVERRIDE stored parameters with the same key. Parameter values arrive as strings. Applies on both immediate app open and after deferred install. No SDK change required. Default: false.

androidFallbackUrl.description: Android-specific fallback URL (e.g. Play Store link)

androidUrl.description: URL to open on Android devices

domainId.description: The domain to host the link on

externalId.description: Optional stable identifier from your system (e.g. 'share:user-123:post-456'). Repeated calls with the same (project, externalId) return the existing link instead of creating a duplicate. Idempotent.

iosFallbackUrl.description: iOS-specific fallback URL (e.g. App Store link)

iosUrl.description: URL to open on iOS devices

metadata.description: Arbitrary metadata attached to the link

parameters.description: Key-value parameters passed through the deep link

projectId.description: The project to create the link in

slug.description: Custom slug for the short URL (auto-generated if omitted)

type.description: Link type: 'unified' for smart routing or 'dynamic' for parameterised deep links

name: create_link
title: Create Link
